title: Wildfly: When Neethi fetches a remote policy reference, it only limits the time per read, not the… (CVE-2026-91867)
description: A vulnerability in Wildfly's Neethi component allows a denial of service condition when fetching remote policy references. The issue arises because the timeout only limits the time per read operation, not the entire transfer. An attacker can exploit this by trickling bytes slowly, keeping the fetch alive indefinitely and tying up the calling thread.
